title: Set complete document titles for Health and other operational routes
description:
Problem: the live browser audit found `/health` rendered with an empty document title while most other primary routes set a route-specific title such as `Pages`, `Memories`, `Chat`, or `About - MemorySmith`. Empty or inconsistent document titles make tab switching and assistive technology navigation harder.

Desired outcome: every primary route sets a stable, descriptive document title using a consistent format.

Scope:
- In scope: `/health` title fix, a quick audit of other operational/admin routes for missing or inconsistent titles, and a small regression check if practical.
- Out of scope: changing visible page headings or route paths.

Acceptance criteria:
- `/health` sets a non-empty title such as `Health - MemorySmith` or the app's current route-title convention.
- Primary operational routes have consistent document-title formatting.
- Browser tests or route-smoke assertions catch future missing titles.

Validation:
- Navigate to `/health`, `/maintenance`, `/admin`, `/tasks`, `/pages`, `/memories`, and `/chat` and confirm `document.title` is non-empty and descriptive.
- Run route-smoke or the focused title assertion test.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from 2026-05-25 live browser audit: `/health` returned an empty document title while other primary routes had route-specific titles.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Implemented by normalizing primary route PageTitle values to the `Route - MemorySmith` convention and adding route-smoke title assertions for `/memories`, `/pages`, `/chat`, `/tasks`, and `/health`. Validation: `dotnet build .\MemorySmith.App\MemorySmith.App.csproj --nologo` succeeded, and `MEMORYSMITH_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5099 npm run test:route-smoke` passed 5/5 against a Development local server on 2026-05-25.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: 2026-08-08 deep-dive found current memorysmith.js buildRouteTitleFallback always returns Health - instance and can overwrite valid route titles; HealthStats also hard-codes the instance name. Historical title-fix completion is contradicted by live code; new TSK-0477 tracks the regression.
